title: Grand total printed by the meterbill September run
prompt:
Finance is reconciling the September usage invoices produced by this repository against their own spreadsheet, which applies the rules in the README by hand. Before we change anything I want to know exactly what the tool currently outputs: when I run

    python3 -m meterbill fixtures/september.json

what value is shown on the final `Grand total:` line?

Answer with the number exactly as the program prints it.
